decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque on the right nasal vestibule
response.rationale: R3 is supported by both clinical and histologic findings (exophytic verrucous plaque and papillary fronds with nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and goblet cells), while R2 only uses the histologic findings and misinterprets them as inverted papilloma; the exophytic architecture and lack of inverted growth pattern favor squamous papilloma. R4 is contradicted by the absence of cytologic atypia. C1 is a completion of R3 but lacks histologic support.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R3 with anatomy modifier but lacks histologic support, making it less complete.
Contradicted by the absence of cytologic atypia and atypical mitotic figures.
